sources.entry: INGInious - Intelligent grader that allows secured and automated testing of code made by students. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: A curated list of plugins for the INGInious automated code-grading platform, covering new problem types and other extensions.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a list of community and official plugins for INGInious, an intelligent grader for secured, automated testing of student code. It is organized into two sections: "Problem types" and "Other plugins". Each entry gives a name, description, AGPL 3.0 license, maintainer and author(s), and in some cases an example. The problem types include a basic template for building new types, math formula answers with symbolic comparison, fill-in-the-blanks with read-only text, Blockly visual block programming, drag-and-drop permutation, custom code box layouts, and partially hidden network protocol traces. The other plugins cover exam restriction with Safe Exam Browser support, highlighting lines from the grader, submission histograms, peer auto-evaluation, LTI iframe resizing, and IntelliJ project skeleton generation. The README itself contains no installation steps; the "Link" fields are empty in the text provided.
use_cases: Adding new question types to an INGInious course
Automated grading of student code with math or drag-and-drop answers
Restricting course access during online exams
Generating IntelliJ starter projects for students
notable: Two-part catalogue: new problem types and other plugins

Link fields are blank in the README, so individual plugin locations must be found separately
